AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

Guidance for coding agents working in this repository. For design and internals, read DEVELOPMENT.md.

What this is

grnland is an R package (R + Rcpp/RcppArmadillo) that simulates populations whose phenotypes are steady states of gene regulatory networks, evolving on adaptive landscapes. It generalises the code behind the paper Developmental Bias Shapes Evolution on Complex Adaptive Landscapes (Netz, Melo & Milocco).

Layout

Path Contents
R/model.R model constructors: grn(), paper_motif(), grn_custom(), locus parsing
R/develop.R develop(), phenotype(), sensitivity(), m_matrix(), genotype_at()
R/linear.R gp_linear(): linear genotype-phenotype map
R/landscape.R landscape constructors, landscape_grid(), find_peaks()
R/simulate.R simulate_population(), selection schemes, stopping rules
R/lande.R lande_separatrices()
src/hill.cpp Hill-network solver and analytical derivatives (the hot path)
tests/testthat/ tests; helper-legacy.R holds closed forms from the original scripts
vignettes/grnland.Rmd getting-started vignette (built by R CMD check)
vignettes/articles/ pkgdown-only article with the paper figures (not built by check)
analysis/ scripts reproducing the paper figures; not part of the package
docs/ built pkgdown site, served by GitHub Pages; committed

Commands

Run from the repository root. Cap BLAS threads for anything that runs simulations.

R CMD INSTALL .                                         # reinstall after any change
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'                           # tests (~1 min)
Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'                       # after editing roxygen comments
Rscript -e 'Rcpp::compileAttributes()'                  # after changing exported C++ signatures
Rscript pkgdown/build_site.R                            # rebuild docs/ (installs the package)
R CMD build . && R CMD check --no-manual grnland_*.tar.gz
  • Analysis scripts and vignettes use the installed package. Reinstall before running them, or they will silently use the old code.
  • Run analysis scripts from analysis/ with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; test them with QUICK=1 first. Full runs take many core-hours; ask before launching them.
  • R CMD check gives one WARNING on the maintainer’s Mac about a missing Homebrew gcc search path. It comes from the local toolchain; anything else is new.

Conventions

  • Edit roxygen comments in R/, never man/*.Rd or NAMESPACE directly.
  • Never edit R/RcppExports.R or src/RcppExports.cpp; regenerate them.
  • regulation[i, j] is the effect of gene j on gene i. Edges are written "a -> b" (a activates b) and "a -| b" (a represses b).
  • Locus codes shared by R and C++: 1 = alpha, 2 = gamma, 3 = theta, 4 = hill. C++ indices are 0-based.
  • Development status codes: 0 ok, 1 no convergence, 2 unstable, 3 non-finite.
  • New behaviour gets a test. Derivative code gets a finite-difference check (see test-general.R); motif results are checked against the closed forms in helper-legacy.R.
  • Keep defaults equal to the settings of the paper’s scripts (haploid clonal, N = 1000, mu = 0.01, sigma = 0.05, selection_relative_min()), unless the change is deliberate and documented in the README.
  • Simulations take a seed and must be reproducible from it.

Docs

docs/ is committed and served at https://diogro.github.io/grnland/. After changing exported functions, the README, the vignette or the article, run Rscript pkgdown/build_site.R and commit docs/ together with the change. The article’s figures in vignettes/articles/figures/ are copied from analysis/figures/; most are from reduced QUICK=1 runs, and the article says so.

Don’ts

  • Don’t commit analysis/output/ or analysis/figures/ (cached results and generated figures; both ignored).
  • Don’t change the random-number call order in simulate_population() without a reason: it changes every seeded result, including the analysis caches.
  • Don’t push, or change repository settings, unless asked.
